ITEM 1 | Whole almonds, light tan to brown oval nuts with smooth skins and pointed ends, scattered in a dense layer covering roughly the upper-right quadrant of the plate, about 0.25 of plate area, piled 1-2 nuts deep; dry, matte surface, no sheen | 55
ITEM 2 | Orange cheese cubes, bright orange with slightly glossy, firm, smooth-cut faces, pieces roughly 2 cm square and 1.5 cm tall, clustered in a small group on the left-upper side of the plate, about 0.08 of plate area; firm, holds shape, no visible crumbling | 45
ITEM 3 | Dried or whole red grapes, dark burgundy-red and some pale green, smooth glossy skins, round about 1.5-2 cm diameter, arranged in a loose cluster on the right-middle of the plate, about 0.12 of plate area, piled 1-2 grapes high; plump, slightly reflective | 75
ITEM 4 | Cooked sausage rounds, medium brown with darker browned edges and slightly glossy, firm surfaces, cut into discs about 2.5 cm diameter and 1-1.5 cm thick, arranged in a stacked group along the lower-left and bottom of the plate, about 0.22 of plate area; some discs show light char marks and a slightly oily sheen | 130
